text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm planning to merge PR #4827 that tightens Vault token scope for the on‑prem sidecar. Need sec review + a quick prod smoke before the 15:30 PT merge window. TL;DR: reduces SA permissions, renames an env var (OLD_SECRET -> ONPREM_SECRET), and adds a migration job.

liam: can you paste the env var rename diff? want to sanity-check our helm values references (charts/dedicated/*).

maria: sure, snippet from the helm template:```diff
- env:
-  - name: OLD_SECRET
-    valueFrom: ...
+ env:
+  - name: ONPREM_SECRET
+    valueFrom: ...
```
Also updated values.yaml -> `onprem.secretName` and added a migration job `jobs/migrate-onprem-secrets` that rebinds the SA.

sam: does the migration require a rolling restart of all onprem pods? need to flag maintenance for customers.

maria: migration runs as a job that touches CRs and writes the new secret ref. pods will pick up via normal coord (we'll patch deployments to force rollout once job completes). Runbook is linked in the PR: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onprem-secret-migration — includes `kubectl patch` commands and a verification step.

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Merge window scheduled at 15:30 PT. Merges that change infra-sensitive config require two approvals and one sec OK or explicit rollback plan set.

liam: Code-wise LGTM from eng side (no API changes). but need confirmation on KMS/HSM path for onprem — alex from sec, could you confirm the keyflow? @alex

alex: skimmed the PR, left one comment about ensuring token material is never logged and to use `log.Redact()` for migration job output. otherwise looks fine. we need a short note in the runbook about KMS fallback if HSM is unreachable. approving pending that tiny change. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will add the log redaction and KMS fallback note now. plan to merge at 15:35 PT (give 5m buffer) if no other blockers. rollback plan documented in PR: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/onprem-sidecar -n onprem` and reapply old secret binding.

sam: who will do the prod smoke? I can take the first check once migration job finishes, then liam can run a quick perf/latency probe.

liam: I can run perf probe. sam, ping me once job shows `Completed` in namespace `onprem-migrations`.

maria: will post back here with job status + commit hash after merge. thanks all for quick reviews.

alex: approved after redaction note added. ping when merged and I'll run the audit-log check.

maria: merged at 15:37 PT — job kicked off. posting job pod logs in a minute.

deploy-bot: Deploy success: job/migrate-onprem-secrets completed in 78s.

sam: verified basic secret lookup and pod restarted as expected. no errors in the quick smoke.

liam: perf probe OK, latency within baseline. marking this as closed from eng side.

maria: great — leaving the post-mortem notes in the PR and the runbook. filing a follow-up issue to add an automatic rollback hook for future migrations. :white_check_mark:
